GLDIO.editor.title: Terrain editor
GLDIO.editor.level.label: Level
GLDIO.editor.level.saved: Base {base}. Has saved terrain. Click to view this Level and edit it.
GLDIO.editor.level.blank: Base {base}. Flat, nothing saved yet. Click to view this Level and edit it.
GLDIO.editor.level.mismatch: You are editing {level}, but the canvas shows {viewed}. Painting lands on {level}. Click {viewed} above to switch.
GLDIO.editor.unsupported: Diorama works on square grids only.
GLDIO.editor.notViewing: View this scene to paint on it. Saving still works.
GLDIO.editor.offNotice: 3D is off for this scene. Players will not be offered the view.
GLDIO.editor.saveFailed: The terrain could not be saved. See the console for details.
GLDIO.editor.bar.outlines: Show height edges and stair arrows
GLDIO.editor.bar.dim: Dim the map under the paint
GLDIO.editor.bar.offOn: 3D is off for this scene. Click to turn it back on
GLDIO.editor.hint.brush: Drag to paint the selected height. Shift erases to floor, Alt or right-click picks the height under the cursor. [ and ] change the size.
GLDIO.editor.hint.rect: Drag a rectangle to fill it with the selected height. Shift erases to floor.
GLDIO.editor.hint.fill: Click to fill the connected area of the same height and kind. Shift fills it with floor.
GLDIO.editor.hint.wand: Click the map art to select similar colours. Shift adds, Ctrl subtracts. Then apply a height to the selection.
GLDIO.editor.hint.raise: Drag to raise the ground by one step. Each stroke raises a spot once.
GLDIO.editor.hint.lower: Drag to lower the ground by one step. Each stroke lowers a spot once.
GLDIO.editor.hint.stairs: Drag across the steps the way they climb. A click works out the direction from the ground around it.
GLDIO.editor.hint.wall: Pick a material, then click walls to assign it. Shift-click resets a wall to the world default.
GLDIO.editor.hint.difficult: Paint whole squares of difficult terrain. Written as Foundry regions when you save, so the ruler and the system agree.
GLDIO.editor.colours.none: This scene has no map art to sample.
GLDIO.editor.colours.load: The map art could not be loaded.
GLDIO.editor.colours.tainted: The map art is on another server without CORS headers, so its colours cannot be read.
GLDIO.editor.colours.failedShort: The map colours could not be read.
GLDIO.editor.palette.title: Heights
GLDIO.editor.palette.full: This scene already has the most heights it can hold.
GLDIO.editor.palette.name: Name
GLDIO.editor.palette.removeBody: Remove {name}? Ground painted with it goes back to floor.
GLDIO.editor.map.title: Map
GLDIO.editor.auto.label: Auto setup
GLDIO.editor.auto.hint: Make a first draft from the map art and the walls: rooms, water, the dark outside, and heights read from shadows and stairs. Asks for its options first. Undoable.
GLDIO.editor.auto.done: Auto setup drafted {rooms} room squares, {water} water squares, {void} void squares and {raised} raised squares ({how}). Check it, then save.
GLDIO.editor.auto.doneNoArt: The map colours could not be read, so the draft uses walls only ({rooms} room squares).
GLDIO.editor.auto.failed: Auto setup failed. See the console for details.
GLDIO.editor.auto.title: Auto setup
GLDIO.editor.auto.intro: Replaces the draft with one read from the map art and the walls. You can undo it.
GLDIO.editor.auto.heightsHint: Off gives a flat draft: rooms, water and void only.
GLDIO.editor.auto.lightHint: Shadows fall away from the light, and the side they fall on is lower. Auto finds the light from the shadows and keeps the draft flat when they don't agree.
GLDIO.editor.auto.facesHint: For maps painted at a slight angle, where the side wall of a terrace shows below its edge. Pick the side the walls show on (usually south). Each wall then reads as a step up away from that side.
GLDIO.editor.auto.scaleHint: How tall a shadow reads. At 1 a shadow is as long as the thing casting it is tall.
GLDIO.editor.auto.how.noLight: no consistent light, so no heights from shadows
GLDIO.editor.layout.label: Import layout
GLDIO.editor.layout.hint: Paste a layout written for this map, by hand or by an AI agent. Replaces the draft. Undoable.
GLDIO.editor.layout.title: Import layout
GLDIO.editor.layout.body: Paste the layout JSON, or choose a .json file. Coordinates are squares from the map's top-left corner.
GLDIO.editor.layout.errors: The layout has {n} problems. The first: {error}
GLDIO.editor.layout.done: Imported the layout ({ops} shapes). Check it, then save.
GLDIO.editor.layout.doneTokens: Imported the layout ({ops} shapes). Its {tokens} tokens move when you save.
GLDIO.editor.layout.tokensMoved: Moved {n} tokens to their layout positions.
GLDIO.editor.layout.tokensMissing: No token on this scene is called: {names}.
GLDIO.editor.bundle.label: Import bundle
GLDIO.editor.bundle.hint: Pick a Map Maker Diorama Bundle folder: its layout and models replace the draft, and the 3D view draws its ground. Undoable.
GLDIO.editor.bundle.errors: The bundle has {n} problems. The first: {error}
GLDIO.editor.bundle.done: Imported the bundle "{name}" ({props} models). Check it, then save.
GLDIO.editor.ground.label: 3D ground
GLDIO.editor.ground.hint: The 3D view draws this image as the ground instead of the scene's background. The 2D map is unchanged.
GLDIO.editor.ground.clear: Draw the scene's background in 3D again
GLDIO.editor.copy.label: Copy
GLDIO.editor.copy.none: No other scene with this map has terrain.
GLDIO.editor.copy.done: Copied the terrain from {scene}. Save to keep it.
GLDIO.editor.clear.label: Clear all
GLDIO.editor.clear.title: Clear all terrain
GLDIO.editor.clear.body: Flatten the whole draft back to floor? You can undo this until you close the editor.
GLDIO.editor.discard.label: Discard
GLDIO.editor.discard.title: Discard changes
GLDIO.editor.discard.body: Close the editor and throw away every change since the last save?
GLDIO.editor.unsaved.title: Unsaved terrain
GLDIO.editor.unsaved.body: This draft has changes that players will not see until you save.
GLDIO.editor.preview.title: Draft in 3D
GLDIO.editor.preview.unavailable: The 3D renderer is not available yet.
GLDIO.editor.preview.failed: The 3D preview could not start. See the console for details.
